objective: Harden the existing live multi-provider render workflow so provider activation checks credentials, render-command configuration, and required server-side SDK availability.

rulesConsidered: Only real render-capable providers may enter F06 routing.
F07 and CAS remain physical truth gates.
No self-hosted PandaStack sandbox is introduced.

security.notes: Workflow changes only; provider credentials are injected from GitHub secrets and are not logged or passed to GLiDE.

changes: Added provider-specific live render command configuration for Kaggle and hosted sandboxes.
Added sandbox activation configuration checks for Daytona and Modal.
Added runtime installation of @daytona/sdk and modal for the manual live workflow.
Kept the installation out of package-lock.json because registry access is unavailable in the agent environment.
Preserved the existing RenderFabric -> ComputePool -> ComputeRouter -> provider -> CAS -> F07 smoke path.
Added a repeatable operator runbook and marked Phase 7 activation-ready without claiming a live provider run.
notes: Actual non-local render execution is intentionally not claimed until a manual workflow run supplies live provider credentials.
The workflow supports AMD, Kaggle, Daytona, and Modal; the hosted sandbox command produces a deterministic 1080x1920 MP4 with audio and keeps F07 authoritative.
